setup.title: Set up WebCraft
setup.lockNote: This wizard locks for good once setup is finished.

token.title: Setup token
token.heading: Enter the setup token
token.intro: When WebCraft started, the web process wrote a one-time setup token in its log. Copy it from there to show that you run this server.
token.label: Setup token
token.help: Look for the log line saying this Install has no Superadmin yet.

account.title: Superadmin account
account.heading: Create the Superadmin account
account.intro: This person administers the whole Install: every Workspace, all Staff and the Install settings.
account.name: Full name
account.passwordHelp: At least 12 characters. You'll be asked to add a passkey or an authenticator app next.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.heading: Protect your account with two-factor authentication
twoFactor.intro: A password alone can be guessed or stolen. With a passkey or an authenticator app, signing in also needs something only you have.
twoFactor.recommend: The Superadmin can reach everything on this Install, so we strongly recommend it.
twoFactor.later: You can also do it later from Your account.

email.title: Install email (SMTP)
email.heading: Set up the Install email
email.intro: WebCraft sends invites, password resets and security notices through an SMTP server, such as your email provider's or a sending service's.
email.later: You can skip this for now: until an SMTP is set, these emails are written to the web log. You can set it later in Install settings › Email (SMTP).

modules.title: Modules
modules.heading: Approve the Modules
modules.intro: Modules are features that come with WebCraft, such as Forms or Site analytics. Each runs only once you approve what it asks for. They are ticked: untick any you don't want yet.
modules.later: You can approve or withdraw Modules later in Install settings › Modules.
modules.none: This version of WebCraft has no Modules waiting for approval.

closed.heading: This Install is already set up
closed.intro: It has a Superadmin, so the setup wizard is closed for good.

switcher.label: Switch Workspace or Site
switcher.heading: Switch to
switcher.workspaceSubtitle: Workspace · {count, plural, one {# Site} other {# Sites}}

masterKeyBanner.title: Back up your Master key
masterKeyBanner.body: WEBCRAFT_SECRET_KEY encrypts every SMTP password, AI key and API token on this Install. If it is lost, they cannot be recovered. Keep a copy somewhere other than this server.
masterKeyBanner.confirmed: Thanks. The banner won't show again for this key.

dialog.title: Back up your Master key
dialog.intro: The Master key is never stored in the database or in a Backup, so a copy kept elsewhere is the only way to read your secrets after losing the server.
dialog.stepCopy: On the server, copy the value of WEBCRAFT_SECRET_KEY from the Install's environment: the .env file next to your Docker Compose file, or your platform's environment variables.
dialog.stepStore: Store it in a password manager or another safe place that is not this server and not a Backup.
dialog.stepSecret: Keep it secret: anyone with the key and a Backup can read every stored secret.
dialog.fingerprintHelp: Backups record this fingerprint, so you can tell which key a Backup needs. It reveals nothing about the key.

setupUnfinished.heading: Setup isn't finished
setupUnfinished.body: A few steps of the setup wizard are left.

securitySettings.heading: Security
securitySettings.intro: How the Install protects people's accounts.
securitySettings.leakedPasswordCheck: Check new passwords against lists of leaked passwords
securitySettings.leakedPasswordCheckHelp: Only the first 5 characters of a password's SHA-1 hash leave the server, so the password itself is never sent. When the lookup can't be reached, the password is accepted. Switch the check off for an Install that is always offline.

storageSettings.heading: Storage
storageSettings.intro: Where the Install keeps uploaded files. Files already stored stay where they are and keep their addresses.
storageSettings.diskHelp: On this server, in {directory}. The web process and the worker must share this folder.

storageSettings.endpointHelp: The service's address, such as https://s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com or http://minio:9000.
storageSettings.regionHelp: Such as eu-west-1; auto for Cloudflare R2.
storageSettings.prefixHelp: Optional. Put in front of every file, so one bucket can hold several Installs.
storageSettings.pathStyleHelp: Most self-hosted stores, such as MinIO, need this.
storageSettings.secretHelp: Stored encrypted under the Master key. It is never shown again.
